notes: Si CoinGecko no contesta, el precio del KDA sale del pool KDA/kb-USDC del Mercado de Kadena, y el total deja de quedarse en 0,00 con los saldos bien. / If CoinGecko does not answer, the KDA price comes from the KDA/kb-USDC pool on the Kadena Market, and the total no longer sits at 0.00 while balances are fine.

notes_i18n.es:
EL PRECIO YA NO DEPENDE DE UN SOLO SITIO
El total en euros o dolares se calculaba solo con el precio de CoinGecko. Cuando CoinGecko no contesta -corta por exceso de peticiones, o bloquea la conexion-, el dashboard se quedaba en 0,00 US$ aunque los saldos en KDA estuvieran bien. Y ademas el precio del KDA en CoinGecko se alimentaba de dos mercados, CoinEx y Gate, y CoinEx ha cerrado.

Ahora, si CoinGecko falla, el precio del KDA se lee del pool KDA/kb-USDC del Mercado de Kadena (chain 2), que la app ya usa para las ordenes y que no depende de ningun exchange. Un kb-USDC se toma por un dolar; para pasar a euros, libras o francos se usa el cambio de la ultima respuesta buena de CoinGecko, que se recuerda una semana. Si nunca la hubo, en esas monedas no se enseña precio: se prefiere el hueco a un numero inventado. La variacion en 24 h no se enseña cuando el precio viene del pool, porque el pool no la sabe.

NADA MAS CAMBIA
Mismas carteras, misma firma, mismas comisiones.
notes_i18n.en:
THE PRICE NO LONGER DEPENDS ON A SINGLE SOURCE
The total in euros or dollars was computed only from CoinGecko's price. When CoinGecko does not answer -rate limiting, or a blocked connection-, the dashboard sat at US$0.00 even though the KDA balances were fine. On top of that, CoinGecko's KDA price was fed by two markets, CoinEx and Gate, and CoinEx has shut down.

Now, if CoinGecko fails, the KDA price is read from the KDA/kb-USDC pool on the Kadena Market (chain 2), which the app already uses for orders and which does not depend on any exchange. One kb-USDC counts as one dollar; to convert to euros, pounds or francs the app uses the rate from CoinGecko's last good answer, remembered for a week. If there never was one, no price is shown in those currencies: a blank beats a made-up number. The 24 h change is not shown when the price comes from the pool, because the pool does not know it.

NOTHING ELSE CHANGES
Same wallets, same signing, same fees.
